about: 24 B2 texts (7 domains × 3 and 3 opinion pieces) and 4 public-domain classics by Franz Kafka (Ein Landarzt, 1919), each with 5 reviewed questions
process: author → machine gates (readers@1 shape, verbatim evidence, answer ranges, targets exist, no sticky-error detector on a sentence) → editor pass → pass A (native de-DE newspaper and textbook editor persona) → pass B (second native editor persona, blind to pass A) → reconcile. Entries are sentences (German and English) and questions. Both passes are model personas: reviewedBy is model-2pass.

licences.pd: Franz Kafka, Ein Landarzt. Kleine Erzählungen (1919/1920), Project Gutenberg eBook #21989; German unchanged (checked byte for byte against the Gutenberg text), English translations our own. See content/NOTICE.md.
